name: ext_R5_Dosage_maxDosePerPeriod
title: Cross-version Extension for R5.Dosage.maxDosePerPeriod for use in FHIR R4
description: This cross-version extension represents Dosage.maxDosePerPeriod from http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Dosage|5.0.0 for use in FHIR R4.

element.short: Upper limit on medication per unit of time
element.definition: `Dosage.maxDosePerPeriod` maps to R4 `Dosage.maxDosePerPeriod`. So is mapped as Equivalent.
